resources.string:
SleepThrough · Sleep data

SleepThrough reads sleep sessions from Health Connect only after you grant Sleep access. Samsung Health must first share sleep data with Health Connect.

We do not modify or delete Samsung Health or Health Connect records. Raw sleep stages stay on this phone in encrypted app storage for up to 28 days. Night summaries may be retained up to 366 days.

Health summaries are sent to your Supabase account only if you separately enable health cloud sync. You can disable this and delete cloud copies in Settings. Raw stages are never uploaded. Your manually entered diary and lesson progress sync only when you choose to sign in.

You can revoke Sleep access in Health Connect at any time. Existing copies can be deleted in SleepThrough Settings. Data is not sent to advertising, AI or product analytics services.

SleepThrough is an educational capstone pilot. Wearable sleep estimates are not a diagnosis. No medical treatment is prescribed.

Open SleepThrough → Settings → Your data to export or delete your copies. Uninstalling clears local data; cloud account data must be deleted separately.
